title: Ergasterion named-rule catalogue v1 (architecture section 3.2)
description: The estate's named-rule catalogue: one neutral signature per rule -- its name, its version, its input types, its output type -- declared once (architecture section 3.2). This schema validates the catalogue document's own shape only. Resolving a declaration's rule reference against a populated catalogue, and the completeness gate that checks every (translator, adapter) pair implements it, are ergasterion/framework/rules.py's job (architecture section 3.4). A rule entry may optionally carry 'implementations': this does not weaken 'implementations are code, never in a declaration' (section 3.2) -- it is a lightweight manifest naming, per (translator, adapter), the dispatch macro that implements the rule, so the completeness gate can resolve an ESTATE-declared rule (one the engine reference catalogue does not ship) the same way it resolves the engine's own REFERENCE_IMPLEMENTATIONS registry. An estate that needs no implementations entry (every rule it references is one the reference catalogue already ships and implements) omits it.

adapter.description: One declared adapter this implementation covers, or null/absent for every declared adapter (the macro has no adapter divergence).
